# Support

## How to get help

rsvp-cms is a community project and is supported on a best-effort basis.

| You want to | Go to |
|---|---|
| Ask a question or share an idea | [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/QuinntyneBrown/rsvp-cms/discussions) |
| Report a bug | [Bug report](https://github.com/QuinntyneBrown/rsvp-cms/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) |
| Request a feature | [Feature request](https://github.com/QuinntyneBrown/rsvp-cms/issues/new?template=feature_request.md) |
| Report a security vulnerability | [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not open a public issue. |

Before you ask, please:

1. Read the [README](../README.md) and the [documentation](../docs/).
2. Search the [existing issues](https://github.com/QuinntyneBrown/rsvp-cms/issues) and discussions.

## Response times

There is no service-level agreement. Maintainers aim to triage new issues within a week.
